concepts.prompt: Game building concept: the fortified entrance facade of an enemy stronghold, 12 m wide, 9 m tall: a thick dark grey weathered stone wall with two squat crenellated towers flanking a big arched gate with heavy iron-banded dark timber doors and a portcullis, a stone stair up to the gate, iron braziers, and hanging oxblood deep-red banners with a black and grey emblem on the towers. Overgrown with a little ivy. Grounded military look matching the Team Tether stronghold in the key art and the castle concept reference. Front-facing facade, isolated. Stylised Palworld-like game art, chunky readable forms, hand-painted PBR look, neutral grey background, no characters.

agent_visual_verdict: Good: dark stone twin-tower gatehouse, arched iron-banded doors, stair, braziers, oxblood banners, ivy; banners only on the front.
